title: Oxidation of ethanol
compartment: Hepatocyte cytosol and mitochondria, then extrahepatic tissues

steps.enzyme: Class I alcohol dehydrogenases (ADH1A, ADH1B, ADH1C), cytosolic
steps.note: CYP2E1 (NADPH, O2) and catalase (CAT, H2O2) also form acetaldehyde
A single ALDH2*2 (rs671) subunit renders the tetramer nearly inactive
The liver releases acetate into blood; extrahepatic tissues oxidise it
